definitions.explanation: A designated location where buses or trams stop to pick up and drop off passengers. More formal than バス{停|てい}.

examples.japanese: {次|つぎ}の{停留所|ていりゅうじょ}で{降|お}ります。
examples.english: I'll get off at the next stop.

examples.japanese: {停留所|ていりゅうじょ}まで{歩|ある}いて5{分|ふん}です。
examples.english: It's a 5-minute walk to the bus stop.

examples.japanese: {停留所|ていりゅうじょ}の{前|まえ}にコンビニがある。
examples.english: There's a convenience store in front of the bus stop.

notes:
USAGE: A formal term for bus or tram stops. In everyday speech, バス{停|てい} (basutei) is more commonly used for bus stops.

RELATED WORDS:
・バス{停|てい} (bus stop - casual)
・{駅|えき} (train station)
・{乗|の}り{場|ば} (boarding area/platform)
・{停車場|ていしゃじょう}/{停車場|ていしゃば} (station - older term)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{停留所|ていりゅうじょ}で{待|ま}つ (to wait at the stop)
・{停留所|ていりゅうじょ}で{降|お}りる (to get off at the stop)
・{最寄|もよ}りの{停留所|ていりゅうじょ} (the nearest stop)
